name: Bankruptcy and Netco separation bulk deal moves
description: After the bankruptcy filings and during the Netco separation, credit, legal and contracts staff repeatedly send spreadsheets of deals or counterparties that must be zeroed, killed or moved into bankruptcy books. The gas risk group (Love, Giron, Gossett) cross-checks each list against the books and sends move requests to IT (Cecilia Cheung), who runs book-move scripts and retranslates. Each move needs its parameters clarified by email.
stall_points: Lists arrive as updates, stragglers and corrections, so versions must be reconciled. Requests lack book ids, commodity code or cutoff date, which forces clarification rounds. The impact on Unify paths is questioned only after thousands of deals are announced for killing.
automation: A master deal-move list that is matched automatically against the books by counterparty and deal id, flagging gaps and duplicates. A parameterised move request would capture source and target book, commodity, cutoff date and Canadian or US logic once, and an impact check would run against Unify paths and volumes before the script executes, with completion sent automatically.
